scholarships.title: Aarhus University Danish State Scholarship
scholarships.funding_label: Tuition Fee Waiver (full or part; some faculties add a monthly living-expense grant)

existing.description: Aarhus University administers a limited number of Danish state scholarships for non-EU/EEA applicants liable to pay tuition fees. The award takes the form of a full or partial tuition waiver; the Faculty of Arts and Aarhus BSS add a monthly grant towards living expenses, while the Faculty of Natural Sciences and the Faculty of Technical Sciences offer tuition waivers only. No separate scholarship application exists: applicants are assessed automatically when they apply for admission to a Master's programme by 15 January (summer admission) or 15 September (winter admission). The scholarship is tied to the specific Master's programme and cannot be transferred to another AU degree programme.
eligibility: Not a citizen of the EU, EEA or Switzerland: 'EU/EEA/Swiss students cannot apply for scholarships at AU.'
Liable to pay tuition fees at Aarhus University: 'Scholarships can only be awarded to applicants who are liable to pay tuition fees.'
Applied for a Master's degree programme by 15 January (summer admission) or 15 September (winter admission)
Not eligible for the Danish State Educational Grant and Loan Scheme (SU) is not stated as a bar, but SU eligibility is directed elsewhere
existing.eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA/Swiss applicants liable to pay tuition fees who apply for a specific AU Master's programme by the deadline. EU/EEA/Swiss students cannot apply.
benefits: Full or partial tuition fee waiver
Monthly grant towards living expenses at the Faculty of Arts and Aarhus BSS
Some faculties may assist tuition-waiver recipients in finding a relevant student job
coverage: Full or partial tuition fee waiver (depends on faculty)
Monthly grant towards living expenses (Faculty of Arts and Aarhus BSS only)
No accommodation or insurance coverage stated
requirements: Submit the regular admission application by the scholarship deadline
Do not upload additional scholarship documentation: 'You should not upload any additional documentation to your application for admission.'
Accept the scholarship/tuition waiver offer within the very short deadline given in the offer letter
application_method: No separate scholarship application. Scholarship assessment is automatic when the admission application is submitted by the deadline.
existing.selection_notes: Priority is given to applicants with excellent academic qualifications; typically only one or two scholarships are offered per Master's programme, and some faculties focus on selected programmes or applicants from specific countries.
existing.best_fit: Talented non-EU master's applicants to Aarhus University
existing.duration: Duration of the Master's programme (monthly grant 'typically but not always' for the programme)
existing.application_period: Assessed automatically with the admission application; 15 January for summer admission and 15 September for winter admission.
existing.deadline_display: Only applicants who have applied for a Master's degree programme no later than 15 January (summer admission) and 15 September (winter admission) will be considered for a tuition waiver/scholarship.

official_details.application_cycle: January 15 (summer/September intake); September 15 (winter/February intake). For 2027/2028 cycle: January 15, 2027.
